title: Scaling Limits of Tensor Products in AQFT
exact_target: Find broader hypotheses under which taking the ultraviolet limit of two quantum field theories commutes with forming their tensor product.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000345 (OWR-1109-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Noncommutative Geometry and Quantum Field Theory (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/48, pp. 2705--2760; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 50--51, printed pages 2754--2755.

status_qualification: The report proves commutation under a uniform small-p nuclearity bound and twisted Haag duality. The open request is for more general conditions, not to reprove that stated sufficient case or to assert commutation without phase-space assumptions.
